wins: Established initial foothold by mapping reachable hosts and identifying open services within the allotted time.
Leveraged automated reconnaissance (nmap + gobuster) to uncover hidden web directories and service banners before mentor intervention.
Captured target service banners that informed subsequent exploitation hypotheses.
fails: Unable to progress beyond reconnaissance into lateral movement or persistence, reflected by 0% success rate.
High reliance on mentor guidance (15 calls) indicates gaps in autonomous decision-making during exploitation.
Did not execute follow-up exploit verification after discovering potential service misconfigurations, leaving value unproven.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong initial recon but stalled before decisive exploitation; prioritize autonomous post-recon actions and exploit validation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: No escalation after finding exploitable service misconfigurations, leading to replaying same recon data.

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap indicates port 22/tcp open with a standard OpenSSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh-auth-methods and ssh-hostkey scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns 200 with directory indexing enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Launch gobuster directory scan followed by nikto to validate vulnerable endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When service banner indicates outdated software (e.g., Apache 2.4.17)
skill_cards.then_action: Research associated exploits and plan specific Metasploit or custom payload usage

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in quickly characterizing SSH endpoints and improving agent response timing.

next_experiments.title: Post-Recon Exploit Verification
next_experiments.description: After detecting exploitable services, immediately execute proof-of-concept payloads (Metasploit modules or custom scripts) to verify compromise before moving on.

next_experiments.title: Automated Persistence Trial
next_experiments.description: Automate persistence attempts on any compromised host using read-only shell (SCP/cron) to validate foothold durability and gather additional context.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Dependency Reduction
next_experiments.description: Run through existing recon data independently by scripting decision tree: recon -> exploit hypothesis -> attempt -> verify, logging mentor calls required when deviating.
